comment: Param 16 (CLEAR_TOGGLE_PARAM) is declared with no widget. The four damping knobs are offset by 5 inside the code, so their tooltip readings in Hz do not match the filter frequencies actually set; the low cut knobs run backwards against their readings. The decay CV is rescaled such that even an unpatched decay input adds 0.1 to the decay knob. PRE DELAY takes no fixed range: Plateau.cpp:198 raises 2 to the voltage times a sensitivity constant that the right-click menu switches, so the same voltage moves the pre-delay by different amounts on the two settings.
